dedupe_keys.name: imdeld industrial machines dataset for electrical load disaggregation poultry feed factory minas gerais brazil

description: IMDELD holds electrical measurements of heavy machinery in a Brazilian poultry feed factory in Minas Gerais, made for load disaggregation research. The IEEE DataPort page says eleven GreenAnt meters were installed, one at the 13.4 kV to 380 V substation transformer and others on two distribution boards and on eight machines (two pelletizers, two double-pole contactors, two exhaust fans and two milling machines), sampling internally at 8 kHz and storing 1 Hz RMS voltage, current and active, reactive and apparent power, from 11 December 2017 to 1 April 2018 (about 111 days, one phase of three). Files include the transformer data (about 247 MB), subcircuits and appliances in CSV and HDF5, and a 2.7 GB NILMTK-compatible package. It was created in December 2018 by five authors from GreenAnt and COPPE/UFRJ and last updated in January 2026; it is an Open Access dataset under CC BY 4.0, free to download with a free IEEE account. A second DOI (10.21227/5d22-2z72, 2019) points to the same dataset. Coverage is one factory site. Caveats: milling machines were measured only in the last 12 days and only one phase was recorded. For simulation it gives real machine-level industrial load profiles to model factory demand, demand response and the load lost when a plant stops. Related catalogue records include the VEA industrial load profiles and the South Korea factory electricity demand response data.
